messages:
maria: Quick ask — can someone run a delta heatmap across A100 / H100 / L40s for gen2-7b with kernel patch r321? We observed a small micro-regression on H100 after r321; want p50 / p95 / p99 + throughput at batch sizes 1,4,8. Also need cold vs warm KV-cache comparisons.

chris: I can take this. Which exact model config should I use (dtype, seq_len, decoding)?

maria: fp16, seq_len=2048, greedy (beam=1), temp=0.0. Use latency-checkset v2 (s3://redwood-bench/latency/latency-checkset-v2.jsonl). Please run NVTX and perf counters if possible.

alex: I'll check H100 pool availability now — might be 1–2h queue. If H100s are blocked I can run A100 + L40s and tag H100 as pending.

kai: For the heatmap CSV please use this header: sku,batch,p50_ms,p95_ms,p99_ms,tokens_per_sec,gpu_util,notes

chris: Plan: run baseline (pre-r321) and r321 patch, each with kv_cache cold and warm. Commands I'll use:
```
./bench_run --model gen2-7b --dtype fp16 --seq 2048 --batches 1,4,8 --dataset s3://redwood-bench/latency/latency-checkset-v2.jsonl --kernel-patch r321 --nvtx --perf
```
I'll capture raw logs + perf counters and post summarized CSV. ETA ~3h (depending on H100 queue).

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: patch r321 rolled to staging at <1856789040> :white_check_mark:

maria: great, thanks. Quick note — if H100 shows >10% p99 regression vs baseline, we should consider reverting r321 or adding a H100-only kernel fallback. Flag me in the thread if that happens.

chris: Will do. I'll run both cold (no priming) and warm (100-token priming to populate KV) so we can separate startup vs steady-state. Posting status + tags when each SKU finishes.

alex: FYI I queued an additional H100 in eu-west-1 for this run — if you want me to run there instead of us-west, say so.

maria: us-west preferred for consistent infra, but only if queue <2h. Otherwise eu-west is fine — just add region column to CSV.

chris: Starting baseline runs on A100 now. Will update with a short summary when done.
